name: --version
description: Print the installed Cursor Agent CLI version and exit.

examples.explanation: Check the installed CLI version before comparing behavior with current documentation.

when_to_use: Use when reporting a bug or confirming compatibility with a documented feature.

name: --api-key
description: Supply a Cursor API key directly for the invocation instead of reading CURSOR_API_KEY.

examples.explanation: Authenticate one invocation with an explicitly supplied key.

when_to_use: Use in a controlled automation environment that injects the key securely.
when_not_to_use: Do not place real keys in shell history; prefer CURSOR_API_KEY or a secret manager.

name: --output-format
description: Select text, JSON, or streaming JSON output when Cursor Agent runs with print mode.

examples.explanation: Return machine-readable output for an automated task.

when_to_use: Use JSON formats when another process will consume print-mode output.

name: --background
description: Start Cursor Agent in background mode and open the composer picker on launch.

examples.explanation: Start a background agent session from the current workspace.

when_to_use: Use when launching work that should begin through the background composer flow.

name: --fullscreen
description: Start Cursor Agent with fullscreen terminal rendering enabled.

examples.explanation: Use the full terminal surface for the interactive session.

when_to_use: Use when a dedicated fullscreen terminal interface is preferable to inline output.

name: --resume
description: Resume a selected chat by identifier or open the resume flow when no identifier is supplied.

examples.explanation: Continue a known chat directly from automation or shell history.

when_to_use: Use when returning to work whose existing conversation context should be retained.

conditions: The selected chat must exist and be accessible.

name: --model
description: Select the Cursor Agent model for the invocation.

examples.explanation: Use an account-available model for a specific task.

when_to_use: Use when automatic model selection is not appropriate for the task.

conditions: Available model identifiers depend on the account.

name: --force
description: Allow commands automatically unless an explicit deny rule blocks them.

examples.command: agent --force "run the test suite and fix failures"
examples.explanation: Allow commands automatically while retaining explicit deny rules.

when_to_use: Use only when the configured deny rules and execution environment provide sufficient safeguards.
when_not_to_use: Do not use merely to avoid reviewing commands in an untrusted repository.

conditions: Explicit deny rules still take precedence.
